name: update_cart
description: Set the quantity of one or more products in the ab.gr cart. quantity is the total wanted, not an amount to add, and 0 removes the product. For products sold by the kilo, check sold_by and the cart afterwards.

items.description: Products to set, e.g. [{"code": "7344931", "quantity": 2}]. code is the product code from search, my_products or purchase_history.
